text.description_html:
Omnia 726/300, Contoured Stainless Steel Door Pull

The Contoured Stainless Steel Door Pull has a unique shape that is sure to be a stand out in any application. It is available with either a brushed or polished stainless steel finish. The 15 Inch Stainless Steel Door Pull is available with thrubolt mounting or back to back mounting (must purchase 2 pulls).

Specifications for the Omnia 726/300 Modern Stainless Steel Door Pull:

  • Overall Length: 14-15/16"
  • Mounting Centers: 11-3/4" Center to Center Hole Spacing
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Material: 304 Solid Stainless Steel

Available in your choice of Brushed Stainless Steel or Polished Stainless Steel

When Selecting a Mounting Hardware:

  • Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.
  • Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Requires 2 pulls.

Sold individually (1 door pull handle). If you order Back-to-Back Mounting please Order 2 Pulls.
